Definition: from G473 and G3354; to mete in return:--measure again.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus says with what measure you mete it shall be measured to you again, and the same measure you give will be given back to you. The word is the measuring returned in kind, the measure meted back.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for measuring again carries no teaching of its own; its warning is Jesus', that the measure we give is the measure we will receive.
